name: DiscoverySourceAccount
title: Discovery source accounts
body: An explicitly selected source account. This documents identity and collection context, not a connection grant or organization membership.

name: DiscoveryObservation
title: Discovery observations
body: A bounded source-backed observation created by Forerunner. Provider text is untrusted data. It is not an inferred project, pain point or verified user commitment.

name: observed_from
title: observed from
body: The source DiscoveryObservation was collected from the target DiscoverySourceAccount. Collection method and sample coverage are recorded in its body. No authority is granted.
